authorization_instruction: continue from here to as far as you can. dont stop for reports. you know i trust in your recommendations. complete the bootstraps if possible. but if you absolutely require my input for something thats a design choice that hasnt been decided yet, then defer it and build around it - if possible.

authoring.title: The certified observer classifies static support margin and airborne impact deadline
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR8.0 arithmetic fixtures, the declared observer computes centered, near-edge, brace-threshold, exhausted-support, no-support, and airborne impact-deadline classifications, mirrors signed static margins, and labels the delayed airborne negative control REACTION_TOO_LATE.
authoring.scope: Only the exact support intervals, COM positions, vertical states, thresholds, timing assumptions, source, and program claim scope certified by br8_20260723T144351Z_90b2c1ce.
authoring.mechanism: The observer compares projected COM position with the current support interval and separately predicts time to declared impact height from vertical state. It reports a reason and urgency but has no force or guidance channel.
applicability: Checking exact one-dimensional static-support margin classification
Distinguishing an actionable airborne deadline from the declared delayed negative control
failure_boundaries: A classification is an observation and does not execute a physical brace, step, or landing response
The support interval is not a full 3D viability region
No free 3D standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: How angular momentum and morphology-specific reach change an actionable deadline
Which physical response can satisfy a detected deadline

authoring.title: The certified linear-capture oracle separates static margin from motion-driven urgency
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR8.1 arithmetic fixtures, the declared oracle computes linear-capture position and boundary time, mirrors velocity and loss direction, distinguishes static from capture urgency, reports a reaction-viable warning when warranted, labels the delayed negative control REACTION_TOO_LATE, and rejects nonfinite velocity.
authoring.scope: Only the declared linear-capture approximation, one-dimensional support interval, COM height and velocity inputs, gravity, thresholds, source, and program claim scope certified by br8_20260723T144351Z_90b2c1ce.
authoring.mechanism: The oracle projects horizontal velocity through the declared linear inverted-pendulum timescale and compares the resulting capture position with the support boundary. A boundary clock estimates when present motion crosses that boundary.
applicability: Detecting motion-driven urgency while static COM margin remains positive
Reporting mirrored loss direction and a bounded reaction-time estimate
failure_boundaries: The linear-capture approximation is not a nonlinear viability kernel or a physical recovery controller
Reaction-viable means only that the declared timing inequality remains open; it does not prove a feasible brace
No executed brace, catch step, free 3D standing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: How angular momentum, finite foot area, and nonlinear dynamics change the boundary
How actuator and contact limits should be incorporated into a true viability estimate

authoring.title: The certified supervisor escalates immediately and releases viability states hysteretically
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR8.2 sequence fixtures, the declared observer supervisor escalates immediately from STAND through PRECARIOUS to BRACE, retains reasoned digest-bound transitions, refuses release below the safe margin, and de-escalates by only one state after each complete safe dwell.
authoring.scope: Only the exact input observations, thresholds, dwell lengths, transition ordering, digest contract, source, and program claim scope certified by br8_20260723T144351Z_90b2c1ce.
authoring.mechanism: Urgent observations raise the reported state without delay, while recovery requires a complete safe dwell and can release only one state at a time. Transition evidence binds the before-state, after-state, reason, and observed input digest.
applicability: Preventing noisy observations from instantly clearing a high-urgency detector state
Auditing why and when a detector state escalated or released
failure_boundaries: BRACE is a detector-state label and not evidence that a physical brace command or action occurred
The supervisor emits no force, torque, step, foot pin, root rescue, creature edit, or guidance command
No free 3D standing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: How detector dwell thresholds should scale with morphology and controller latency
How a future actuator should acknowledge or reject an observed BRACE state

authoring.title: The certified passive scaffold matrix detects impulse, tilt, and support-removal urgency
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR8.3 passive Godot/Jolt fixtures, a declared central horizontal impulse produces capture-driven BRACE while static margin and reaction time remain, a slowly tilting platform passes through PRECARIOUS and BRACE before measured static support exhaustion, and declared right-support removal is observed and classified on its declared tick.
authoring.scope: Only the exact rigid-body geometry and masses, contact set, unpowered Generic6DOF planar guide, friction, central impulse, platform-rotation schedule, support-removal tick, thresholds, timestep, solver, engine, source, and program claim scope certified by br8_20260723T144351Z_90b2c1ce.
authoring.mechanism: Measured transforms, velocities, and contact membership feed the observation-only detector and hysteretic supervisor. The fixture interventions disturb the passive scaffolded bodies; the detector does not apply a response.
applicability: Checking detector timing against one declared central impulse and slow tilt
Checking same-tick observation and classification of one declared support removal
failure_boundaries: The unpowered guide is a material scaffold that locks out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw
The detector and supervisor execute no brace, step, new support contact, root rescue, or creature guidance
REACTION_TOO_LATE is a negative-control classification and not evidence of a failed physical brace
No free 3D standing, unconstrained balance, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
unknowns: Whether the observations remain timely when out-of-plane degrees of freedom are released
Whether a finite articulated brace or catch step can act before the detected deadline
How detector thresholds generalize across morphology, terrain, and disturbance direction
